d: Redmi Turbo 5 is a new Series launched by Redmi for the first time in India and this Redmi Turbo 5 is one of the most powerful Redmi smartphones launched in India after a long time, It's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra SOC, comes with 8/12 GB LPDDR5x RAM and 256 GB UFS 4.1 storage it has a 50MP rear camera and 8MP Ultra wide it also comes with a massive 7540 mAh battery with 100W fast charing.
